title: Апероль Шприц
notes: NO ingredient list: the only list is under 'Приготовление:' and each line is simultaneously a step and an ingredient (the same raw lines appear in both). 'Ингредиенты спешиваются в пропорции 3:2:1' is a sentence starting with 'Ингредиенты' that is NOT a list header, and '3:2:1' is a ratio, not amounts. Amounts are '~90 мл' glued to a closing parenthesis. 'содовая,тоник' = alternatives without a space (kept as one ingredient). Title extracted from guillemets in 'Рецепт самого вкусного коктейля «Апероль Шприц»'.
